adjudication.rationale: Verified in the diff: `Admin::GroupsController#update` sets `group.name = params[:name] if params[:name] && !group.automatic`, so a rename request on an automatic group is silently ignored while still allowing other fields (e.g., `visible`) to be updated, and the comment explicitly says “group rename is ignored for automatic groups”. In contrast, the newly added membership endpoints `add_members` / `remove_member` both do `return can_not_modify_automatic if group.automatic` and return a 422. This is a real, diff-grounded consistency/semantics concern (API behavior differs between endpoints) but not a clear functional defect since the silent skip is explicitly coded and tested (`spec ... ignore name change on automatic group`).
